name: Amanoiwato Shrine

en.name: Amanoiwato Shrine
en.description: Amanoiwato Shrine venerates the sacred cave where, according to Japanese mythology, the sun goddess Amaterasu hid herself, plunging the world into darkness until lured out by the other gods. The cave itself is across the river and can be viewed with shrine staff escort. The shrine's peaceful forest setting exudes a profound spiritual atmosphere.
highlights: Sacred cave of the Amaterasu legend

ja.name: 天岩戸神社
ja.description: 天岩戸神社は日本神話で天照大神が天岩戸に隠れ、世界が暗闇に包まれた伝説の洞窟を祀る神社です。洞窟は川向かいにあり神職の案内で拝観できます。静かな山中の境内は神話の世界に想いを馳せる神聖な空気に満ちています。
highlights: 天照大神伝説の天岩戸洞窟
日本神話の聖地を訪ねる
山中の静寂な神社と神域の森
